summary: Join our Ethical Leadership and Decision Making Course to develop essential skills for responsible leadership and effective decision-making in your organization
lede: Ethical leadership training helps leaders and professionals responsible for organizational integrity make decisions amid competing pressures and stakeholder expectations. They practice structured ethical decision-making, identify cognitive biases, assess stakeholder impacts, and develop codes of conduct and whistleblowing processes. The syllabus also covers ethical risk assessment and methods for evaluating organizational culture.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals who are responsible for maintaining organizational integrity and making high-impact decisions under pressure.
modules: Foundations of Ethical Leadership and Decision Making
Ethics in the Digital and AI Era
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3 years of professional experience in a management, compliance, or specialist role. Familiarity with basic organizational governance structures is recommended. No prior training in philosophy or ethics is required.
